page.notes: Two right-margin notes: "2. Refp." beside the line "cor habenti novum cor" and "Remonstr." beside "titura"; both are small italic printed marks, transcribed as shown. Spelling of the printed "Refp." and "Remonstr." is as read; the marginal "Remonstr." mark may be a catchword-like symbol, not fully certain. The line "dum" at the top is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The printed page number is read as 421 (top right), with a faint mark beside it. The last word of the page "effu-" is broken with a printed hyphen and continues on the next page.
